name: Outlined character sticker
summary: A drawn character with a thick outline, a white cut-out edge and one short word.
how: Draw a 3px dark line and a 6px white edge round the figure.
Make the head 50% of the body height and use 1 to 3 strokes for the mouth.
Add 1 to 3 words in rounded type in a corner.

origin.note: The LINE messenger launches with drawn sticker packs that users buy and send.

adoptions.via: LINE sticker packs spread the form across Asia, and other messengers copy it.
